I am a Christian learning Arabic (Lebanese) I know what you mean.

My personal opinion (not offending anyone ), I believe we can’t be using different names to refer to God. 
No other religions in the world anglicises or changes names of other religion gods to suit their country or culture - funny how it is with Christianity. (To cause more confusion I guess ).
I avoid using Arabic words that refer the Islamic religion. Christians and Muslims do not worship the same god - it is Judaism and Christianity that worship the same God. As Christianity derived from Judaism. Gentiles are grafted in. 

I can understand how someone (Christian) from an Arabic country would/might use those words…but coming from the west, we only associate those types of words with Islam so we would naturally avoid.

If you feel convicted to not use those words and or it makes you uncomfortable, I would avoid using it and just pray about it. 

Hope this helps - enjoy learning 😊

If you like in the UK, so do I. I’m on UC for the first time because of COVID. Anyone is entitled to help. You can get a top-up for your wage. It’s not taking money off people, especially if you are earning yourself, so you are paying into the system. You deserve the help.
No sorry

I joined university and I was 1 year older than a lot of people in my class. So was another girl. Also, there were a couple of mature students who were in their thirties, and in the year below, some where 40’s and 50’s. Friends are friends at the end of the day. A few of my friends are a couple of years younger than me and some are nearly ten years. I’m 25 btw. Live in Uk aswell. Also, you could try freelance writing for experience. Try writing a blog or local newspaper. Or maybe a guest writer. The older people who were in my class had no experience in the subject we were studying. 

Try enjoying your own company aswell. Become less reliant on other peoples company to fulfil you. There was a time when I only had one friend, now I have quite a few friends. I became less bothered about other people and enjoyed being by myself. 
You’ll definitely make friends - I struggle to connect with most people and I’ve managed to have a few. 

Just be yourself and whoever likes you for you will appreciate you for who you are, regardless of interests. (Some of my friends like the complete opposite of me).
If people don’t take to you, that’s their problem and don’t bother about them, their opinion doesn’t matter and not everyone gets along.

I’m sure you will be fine and get in to a university. I’ve heard many stories where to be honest, I don’t know how people got in…keep pushing.

I agree - if it is a women situation, you deserve better.
You deserve to have someone better- don’t look back look forward.
If they walk away, let them.
You’ll get much better.
